name: WordWar: 1v1 Word Game
subtitle: Race a live rival to the word
promotionalText: Race a live opponent to the hidden word. Fast 1v1 matches, daily challenges and season rewards. Free to play!
whatsNew: New: leaderboard rewards! The top 100 players on the daily, weekly and monthly leaderboards and in the Daily Challenge now win coins. The game screen also fits smaller phones, and our App Store page is now translated into 50 languages (the game itself is played in English).
shortDescription: Race a live opponent to crack the same hidden word. Fastest solver wins.
description:
Think you’re fast with words? Prove it — live.

WordWar is a real-time 1v1 word game: you and your opponent get the SAME hidden word and race the same clock. Guess in rows of letter tiles — green means right letter, right spot; yellow means right letter, wrong spot. You see your rival’s tile colours update in real time, but never their letters. First to crack it wins.

⚔️ REAL-TIME DUELS
No turn-taking. Both players solve at once while the clock ticks. Read your opponent’s progress from their colours and outrace them.

🏆 RANKED CLIMB
Win to climb eight tiers — Stone, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master, Legend. Every match moves your Elo. Seasons reset the ladder so anyone can rise.

🎮 FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic Ranked — race the same word, 1v1
• Mystery Duel — you each submit a word and crack each other’s
• Daily Challenge — one shared word for the whole world, ranked by guess count
• Friends — private live matches by invite or code

⚡ EARN POWER-UPS
Reveal a letter, Scramble your rival’s view, or Lock their power-ups. Earn them through play, win streaks and daily rewards.

🎨 MAKE IT YOURS
Unlock board themes, victory animations, avatars, nameplates, and profile borders. Full colour-blind mode with high-contrast tiles.

📈 TRACK EVERYTHING
Win rate, streaks, rank history, and full match replays so you can study how every duel played out.

Fair by design: the answer never leaves the server, every guess is validated and scored server-side, and all ranking is computed server-side.

Download WordWar and start your first duel in seconds.
